    Component demos stretch the visible effects to 30 seconds. Workbook AUTO mode uses a 4-second door cycle and a short beep. This is a browser simulation.

    ACTIVITY 9 / CAN AI HELP US SAVE ENERGY?

    Train. Test. Improve with evidence.

    The workbook’s four-hour AI route, with a camera-free browser rehearsal.

    HOURS 1–2 · DATA → DECISION TREE

    Possible waste? Ask for a review.

    Train on 40 labelled simulated rows. Test on 16 separate unseen rows.

    Training CSV · 40 rows · Test CSV · 16 rows

    Features: observed brightness, temperature, PIR event, light state and fan state.

    Ready to train.The browser learns a small decision tree. Simulated results cannot establish real-world accuracy or savings.
    HOUR 3 · GESTURE REHEARSAL

    Simulate a recognised gesture.

    Choose a pretend prediction. No camera opens.
    HOUR 4 · FIVE-MINUTE COMPARISON

    Same light. A better threshold?

    Try changing the original high limit from 2000 to 1700.

    How is this a fair test?

    Both trials start OFF and replay the same six 50-second scenes. Natural light is a separate simulated observation. The test counts ON-seconds and time with useful lighting.

    Ready to test. Can you reduce ON-time and keep useful lighting?

    Pause & think · Does less LED ON-time prove lower electricity use without measuring power?

    Teacher’s corner · workbook alignment and model limits

    Use SENSE to read the inputs, CONNECT to rehearse a command, CONTROL to compare modes, and AUTOMATE to test thresholds. PIR detects a movement event. All readings, communication and output effects are simulated.
